caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of three main parts, all illustrated in shades of black and gray. The upper section features a large, teardrop-shaped plate with three round holes, an outward-pointing tip, and an attached hook with a flat circular plate. The middle section connects the top and bottom plates via a smoothly curved cylindrical rod. The bottom section consists of a smaller teardrop-shaped plate, also with two visible round holes, secured to the end of the rod. The object appears to be mounted or designed to be mounted onto a surface. The background is an off-white color with slight discolorations, and the artist’s signature, "J. Staloff," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Door Handle
